status: B-01 design contract; runtime enforcement deferred to B-02 through B-10

science.environment: isolated gas-phase molecule; no solvent, field or embedding

rules: repeat commands and new Runs do not reset totals
all three model limits must pass

model.sdk_selection: B-04 must pin pyproject.toml and uv.lock and verify; no compatibility claim yet
model.protocol: local validated JSON proposal; no provider native Tool Calls
model.token_reservation: Before B-04 validates a tokenizer or conservative UTF-8 byte bound with framing overhead, reserve the entire 12000 input + 2000 output token ceiling; no actual send until bounded serialization is verified. Never treat character count as token count.
model.unknown_usage: keep full reservation, mark unknown; known usage settles actual without erasing HTTP count
model.retry: 401/403 never retry; at most one explicit network/429 retry, Retry-After capped by remaining Run deadline and 60 second request bound; every send reserved separately

required: current results with source hashes and rule versions
compact registry catalog then required schemas
never_include: acceptance expected action labels including window/source/fixture names
context.sampling_input: Use the manifest's model_context_fixture with opaque model_window_id/model_candidate_id; internal left/right/stop labels never enter the serialized model request. B-04/B-09 must inspect final HTTP JSON for leakage.
context.compression: preserve authoritative goals and uncertainty; read evidence by bounded references

test_gates.current: Only --live-orca and live/backend exist; no changes to conftest in B-01

planned_B-04.network: configured DeepSeek HTTPS only; reject redirects

test_gates.ordinary_tests: both live flags must not relax ordinary offline test isolation
